source: A disposable copy of the synthetic APFS payload image was attached read-write, populated with a file that uses four separate extents, detached, and exported by Apple hdiutil.
steps: Attach the disposable copy at a scratch mount point with hdiutil attach -readwrite -nobrowse -noautoopen -plist.
Append four 4096-byte blocks to fragmented.bin and fsync after each write. For each step write and fsync an interleave-{step}.bin filler of 256KiB between appends.
Detach the disposable image. Export with hdiutil convert -format UDTO.

native_checker.warnings: Regular-file device features were unavailable. The offline read-only fsroot, extent-reference, and container checks completed.

fixtures.encoding: Each record pairs a little-endian u64 physical block address with 4096 byte-for-byte native block bytes.
